fusions.name: Flatten
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A crushing tail blow that deals 20 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Plate Slam
fusions.desc: Slams down on your plates, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Levelled Rampart
fusions.desc: Raises a wall 4 tiles long that blocks enemies for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Hammering Back
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by something other than fire, your physical damage rises by 40% for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
